name: KUT Fortnightly Issue
description: Kampala Uganda Temple — the fortnightly drawing issue. (1) Revision leak check FAILS the run when any sheet's STING revision stamp disagrees with the revision it is actually issued at (a draft or stale value would otherwise reach the title block, the file names and ACC). (2) Issue Sheets for Revision issues the open draft revision to every sheet carrying its clouds, refusing a revision/suitability pair ISO 19650 does not allow (P needs S0-S7, C needs A/B/CR); unattended it never prompts and never issues a revision with no clouded sheet, and on success it updates linked deliverables (revision from the Revit issue, IssuedDate), the document register and proposes matching issues as RESPONDED (never closes them). (3) Title-block revision sync writes the ISSUED revision, numbered per sheet. (4) Sheet compliance. (5) Scheduled Export Centre jobs produce the issue set (configure a job in the Export Centre first). (6) ACC Publish packages the deliverables and (7) uploads that bundle; both ACC steps fail the run on error. (8) MIDP drift report compares planned dates against the IssuedDate just recorded — it asks for the MIDP CSV, so it runs only in an attended run and is optional. Needs %APPDATA%/Planscape/acc_credentials.json and _BIM_COORD/acc/acc_settings.json (cdeFolders) for the ACC steps.

steps.label: 1. Revision leak check — fail if any sheet stamp disagrees with its issued revision
2. Issue the open draft revision to its clouded sheets (ISO 19650 revision/suitability gate; updates deliverables, register, issues)
3. Title-block revision sync (issued revision, numbered per sheet)
5. Export the issue set (due Export Centre scheduled jobs)
6. Package the issued deliverables into the ACC bundle
7. Upload the bundle to ACC (CDE folder by suitability)
8. MIDP drift report — planned vs actual issue dates (attended runs: asks for the MIDP CSV)
